The company offers instrument panel, overhead filing cabinet, door trim, column trim, drainage channel cover, bumper, and seat assemblies. It imports and exports various products and technologies products. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.

603197.SS.longBusinessSummary: Shanghai Baolong Automotive Corporation manufactures and sells automotive parts and components. It provides automotive rubber and metal parts, including traditional and tire pressure monitoring system valves; electronically controlled air suspension system; automotive metal tubing, such as exhaust pipes, EGR pipes, roof rail, and metal brackets; and automotive structural parts. It also provides tire pressure monitoring system; automotive sensors, that includes pressure rain and light, speed and position, current, and accelerator sensors; intelligent drive solutions; and automotive aftermarket and equipment products. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

603200.SS.longBusinessSummary: Shanghai Emperor of Cleaning Hi-Tech Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides water treatment services in China and internationally. The company offers water treatment specialty and process chemicals, disinfection and purification products for enclosed and confined spaces, lithium-ion solid-state battery electrolyte powders, and silicon-carbon anode materials, as well as automated intelligent control online dosing systems. It also provides water treatment solutions, including data center air-cooling and liquid-cooling system equipment, water treatment equipment system integration and operation management, sponge city construction, black and odorous water body treatment, and hazardous waste disposal and resource utilization. In addition, the company engages in international trade; leasing and business services; municipal engineering; technology promotion and application services; software and information technology services; and computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing. It serves the petrochemicals, steel metallurgy, automotive electronics, pulp and paper, civil and public buildings, water pollution control, data centers, and new energy batteries industries. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

603225.SS.longBusinessSummary: Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells polyester filament and staple fiber. The company offers semi-dull flat polyester pre-oriented yarn; DTY, FDY, and POY composite series; original solution coloring; staple fiber; polyester slice; and purified terephthalic acid. It also provides moisture wicking fiber, hollow thermal fiber, flame retardant fiber, polyester imitation cotton, comfortable flat fiber, and antibacterial fiber. Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tongxiang, China.

603233.SS.longBusinessSummary: DaShenLin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, distribution, and retail of pharmaceutical products in China. It offers Chinese and Western patent medicines, ginseng and tonic herbs, Chinese herbal medicine slices, health products, medical devices, and other commodities. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Guangzhou, China.

603256.SS.longBusinessSummary: Grace Fabric Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of E-glass fiber cloth in China, Hong Kong, Asia, North America, and Europe. It offers medium and high-end fabrics, including extremely thin fabric, super thin fabric, and thin e-glass fabrics, as well as special electronic-grade glass fiber cloth with low dielectric and low coefficient of thermal expansion, and electronic yarns. The company exports its products. Its products are used in automotive structure parts, electrical and thermal insulation, construction materials, aeronautics and aerospace, and sports and leisure applications. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China. Grace Fabric Technology Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Asia Wealth International Limited.

603259.SS.longBusinessSummary: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, provides research and manufacturing services to discover, develop, and manufacture spectrum for small molecule drugs in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through WuXi Chemistry, WuXi Testing, WuXi Biology, and Others segments. It offers contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CDRMO) services for new drug development from discovery to commercial covering various categories for various synthetic molecular modalities, including small molecules, oligonucleotides, peptides, and complex conjugates; and biology services and solutions which support stand-alone and integrated projects from target discovery to candidate selection and into the clinic. The company also provides laboratory testing services, such as toxicology, DMPK, and bioanalytical services; clinical contract research organization services, including Phase I to Phase IV clinical development services, and bioequivalence for products including pharmaceuticals and biologics; and site management organization, patient recruitment, site start-up, and academic research organization. In addition, it offers services for biology; CDRMO platform for small molecules, oligonucleotides, and peptides; drug research and development testing; and clinical research services. WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

603260.SS.longBusinessSummary: Hoshine Silicon Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of silicon-based materials in China and internationally. It offers solar panels, including N-type monocrystalline high-efficiency bifacial modules; silicon metals, silicon metal powders, and fine silicon metal powders; and graphitized carbon electrodes. The company also provides silicone monomers comprising methyltrichlorosilane, dimethyldichlorosilane, trimethylchlorosilane, and methyldichlorosilane; silane intermediates that include tetramethyldisiloxane, dimethylcyclosiloxane, hexamethylcyclotrisiloxane, octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane, and decamethylcyclopentasiloxane; methyl vinyl and liquid silicone rubbers; room temperature vulcanized silicone rubbers; acetic and neutral silicon sealants; silicon fluid, such as hydroxyl terminated polydimethylsiloxane linear, high boiling silicone oil, methyl hydrogen silicone fluid, polydimethylsiloxane, and vinyl terminated silicone fluid; and precipitated and fumed silica products. Its products are used in aerospace, military, electronic communications, photovoltaic new energy, health care, automobile, and other applications. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Cixi, China.

603267.SS.longBusinessSummary: Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of electronic components in China and internationally. The company operates through Self-Produced Business and Agency Business segments. It offers ceramic capacitors and components, filters, microprocessors, microcontrollers, microwave modules, micro-nano system integrated ceramic shells, and supporting integrated circuits. In addition, the company provides resistors, inductors, RF devices, discrete devices, connectors, integrated circuits, and other products. It serves aerospace, aviation, electronic information, weapons, ships, automotive electronics, communications, rail transportation, medical electronics, industrial, consumer, and other reliability sectors. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China.
603267.SS.longName: Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.

603288.SS.longBusinessSummary: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. engages in the production and sale of condiments, food and agricultural products, and beverages in China. The company offers soybean paste, soy sauce, flavoured sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, cooking wine, and compound seasonings. It also engages in packaging materials and glass bottles packaging and catering services. The company exports its products worldwide. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Foshan, China. Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Guangdong Haitian Group Co., Ltd.
603288.SS.longName: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd.

603290.SS.longBusinessSummary: StarPower Semiconductor Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of power semiconductor chips and modules in Asia and internationally. The company offers IGBT, SiC, IPM, MOSFET, FRD, and diode modules, as well as discrete devices and customized modules. Its products are used in industrial control applications, including low voltage inverters, medium and high voltage inverters, and welding machines; automotive electronics applications consisting of main and auxiliary drives; renewable energy applications, such as photovoltaic power generation, SVG/APF, wind power, power, and energy storage systems; and household appliances, including white goods and commercial air conditioning. StarPower Semiconductor Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.

603296.SS.longBusinessSummary: Huaqin Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and operation services of intelligent products in China and internationally. The company offers personal electronics, including smart phones, tablets, and laptops; smart wearables; VR and AR, smart speaker, smart door lock, and TV; automotive electronics comprising intelligent cabin, connection, driving, and vehicle control; commercial devices which include POS, mobile data collection terminals, intelligent door locks, intelligent speakers, smart office, industrial webcams, and edge computing; and general purpose servers, network switches, heterogeneous servers, and edge servers, as well as digital scenes. It caters to global technology companies and the consumer electronics industry. The company sells its products through direct sales force, distributors, and global brand customers. Huaqin Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Huaqin Technology Co.ltd. and changed its name to Huaqin Co., Ltd. in December 2020. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
